## Two-column lesson with table and formula LEFT COLUMN Mitosis produces genetically similar daughter cells. Prophase is followed by metaphase, anaphase, and telophase. RIGHT COLUMN Meiosis contains two divisions and produces haploid cells. Independent assortment increases variation. Formula: P(A and B) = P(A) \* P(B)
